mapper.sql: SELECT CAST(p.GUID AS varchar(36)) AS guid, p.[No] AS productCode, p.Barcode AS barcode, COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.[Name])), ''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(s.NameP)), '')) AS supplierName, p.NameP AS nameForeign, p.[Name] AS nameChinese, p.QuantityBk AS quantity, p.PurchasePrice AS purchasePrice, p.PurchasePriceTax AS purchasePriceTax, p.TaxRate AS taxRate, p.RetailPriceTax AS retailPrice FROM dbo.Products p LEFT JOIN dbo.Suppliers s ON s.GUID = p.DefaultSupplierGUID
